note: Cross-repo contract for GET /api/auth/status. This file is duplicated byte-for-byte in work-address/app and work-address/web; they are separate repositories, so each owns a copy. app asserts it SENDS these fields with these types; web asserts it READS them. Changing one without the other breaks sign-in and mail in production in a way neither suite would otherwise catch, so change both in the same pull request or not at all.
